reader_summary.headline: My guest today is David Rubenstein.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is David Rubenstein, co-founder of The Carlyle Group - one of the largest private equity firms in the world. David has worked in the White House, built a $300 billion investment institution, become a prominent philanthropist, published books, and even hosts his own TV show. It was a thrill to sit down with him and cover the whole spectrum of his experience as a father, investor, historian.

key_points.text: It was a thrill to sit down with him and cover the whole spectrum of his experience as a father, investor, historian.
